metadata.title: Device Telemetry and Command Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting telemetry and command data exchanged between devices and their control environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Device telemetry channels, command links, control networks, wireless interfaces, and cyber‑physical communication paths.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining confidentiality, integrity, and availability expectations for device telemetry and command data.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines telemetry and command data as execution‑relevant information requiring protection, not as authorization or safety signals.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Establishes baseline expectations for protecting device‑generated and device‑consumed data.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for protecting telemetry and command data across device interfaces.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that all device communications must be explicitly protected and contextually evaluated.

metadata.remarks: Device Telemetry and Command Data Protection defines baseline protections for telemetry and command data exchanged by devices. This pattern does not assert command authorization, safety, correctness, or regulatory compliance.

components.title: Telemetry Confidentiality
components.description: Protection of device telemetry against unauthorized disclosure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Telemetry data is protected against unauthorized access.

components.title: Telemetry Integrity
components.description: Protection of telemetry data against tampering or manipulation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Telemetry data integrity is protected end‑to‑end.

components.title: Command Data Protection
components.description: Protection of command data against interception, modification, or replay.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Command data paths are protected against compromise.

components.title: Telemetry and Command Data Availability
components.description: Protection of telemetry and command channels against disruption or loss.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Telemetry and command channels maintain availability appropriate to device role.

components.title: Telemetry and Command Data Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what protected telemetry or command data does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protected data does not imply authorization, safety, correctness, or approval.
